────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Inline marks on a task's text; resolved dialogue moves to a history file                                                                                        
↑───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                                                                                                                                                                
GOAL                                                                                                                                                            
The ticket stays the crisp working document. A person or agent marks a piece of a task's text with a comment, question or request that sits inline in the       
text, visible as text, with a recognizable sigil. The agent picks marks up, acts or answers, and resolves each by rewriting the ticket text to the clarified    
result and removing the mark. The dialogue that led there (the mark, replies, who and when) is appended to a history file attached to the task, never kept in   
the ticket.                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                
PURPOSE                                                                                                                                                         
Jørgen 2026-11-19 08:55Z: attach a request to a piece of the text in a mark mode, so the AI knows exactly what it is about; questions today look like           
acceptance                                                                                                                                                      
criteria. 09:05Z (answer 1 on this task): threads inside the ticket would bloat it, and the conversation must not become the thing. The ticket must stay        
crisp: clarity comes from boiling text down to its essence. The messy part goes to a separate, suitably named history file in the task's files (provenance,     
chat history) that grows by appending.                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                
PRINCIPLE                                                                                                                                                       
Ticket = working document, short and current. History = append-only provenance file, linked from the ticket, never needed to understand the ticket. Marks are   
plain text in the field they are about, so git, grep, any editor and any agent see them. Resolving a mark means changing the ticket, not adding to it. The      
agent instruction: lead with clarity in the ticket, answer and act on marks, post new questions as marks, move the dialogue to history. Reuse an existing       
markup convention for the sigil if one fits.                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                
DETAILS                                                                                                                                                         
Supersedes the 08:56Z thread sketch (threads in ## Threads, rejected by Jørgen 09:05Z). Replaces ## Questions and ## Requests over time (q2adr8, hbgybn): open  
marks show in ASKED / requests as those do now; delivery as gmzd87. History file name, format and sigil are open design questions on this task. Candidate       
sigil: CriticMarkup ({==marked text==}{>>jhf: comment<<}), an existing plain-text review convention. TUI: a mark mode in the detail view selects a span; c      
comment, ? question, r request; open marks are highlighted calmly (qh9ep1 check 9) and a key jumps between them.
